Execute the Python script at /home/ubuntu/pha_email_report.py to generate the HTML report and detect any changes from the previous day's snapshot at /home/ubuntu/pha_snapshot.json. The content field should be the full HTML string. The email should include all 43 properties, portfolio KPI stats (1BR/2BR/3BR/4BR averages), a changes section (or "No Changes" if none), regional summary, and the full property table with color-coded payment tiers.
